name: release-checklist-tool
description: Release Checklist Tool - modern web application with GraphQL API, React SPA, and PostgreSQL

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test:diagnose: powershell -Command "$diag = Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'diagnose-bottleneck.js' -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; npm run test:stress; Stop-Process -Id $diag.Id -Force"
